children: Janus Living amended and restated its Credit Agreement effective Sep 17, 2026, increasing the revolving credit facility from $500 million to $1.25 billion, with the option to further expand the combined revolver and incremental term loans to $1.75 billion subject to additional lender commitments. In connection with the restatement, the company terminated its prior $100 million delayed draw term loan facility. The refinancing is intended to enhance liquidity and financial flexibility for ongoing operations and growth initiatives.
